title: Cruise ships?
content: Any of you ever have dreams taking place on cruise ships, and if so, does anything wacky happen on them? Because I've had a few and in all of them, the cruise ship just began, malfunctioning,,,in inexplicable ways. Like the ship would skip entire portions of the trip, or huge chunks of the ship would just stop existing for a few minutes only to come back into existence like nothing happened, or the ship would suddenly be diverted to Kerguelen (it's ALWAYS Kerguelen?) instead of wherever the actual destination was. The ship itself varies in looks. Sometimes it's like an old-style cruise ship, sometimes it's a new-style cruise ship. But it's always BIG, with multiple floors, and people that don't seem to know why they're even there.
